summary: File-selection dialogs in the Z Correct dressup, Job Output tab, CAMotics export and the Post Process dialog now open at the job's resolved output location or the document's folder; the Job Output tab adds a confirmation box before replacing the filename template, and the Post Process dialog's Output tab is now pre-filled with the resolved output folder and the template basename.

pages.reason: Path/Main/Gui/Job.py: setPostProcessorOutputFile now seeds the Select Output File dialog from FilenameGenerator (or the document folder) and pops a 'This will replace filename template / Are you sure?' confirmation before setting PostProcessorOutputFile

Path/Post/Gui/DlgPostProcess.py: new _populate_output pre-fills the Output tab's Output folder (resolved from FilenameGenerator) and Filename template (basename of Job.PostProcessorOutputFile); _browse_output_location falls back to the document folder
Shares the dialog from DlgPostProcess.py but the page only covers selection behaviour; dialog details live on output/post-process.adoc
Path/Dressup/Gui/ZCorrect.py: Select Probe Point File dialog only changes its starting folder and filter string; the page does not describe the dialog's default location
Path/Main/Gui/Camotics.py: Save Project As dialog only changes its starting folder to the document directory; no documented behaviour changes

meta.title: CAM: Use current file path as default for file selection dialog
